provenance.method: Intent families drafted from AGGREGATE OpenAlex primary_topic counts of the frozen corpus (data/processed/openalex/works.jsonl, 18,251 works; top topics: Information Retrieval and Search Behavior 1586, Topic Modeling 1286, Recommender Systems 481, Complex Network Analysis 454, Advanced Text Analysis 451, ...); allocation roughly proportional to topic mass. NOT derived from any qrels entry or corpus document: no individual title/abstract was consulted. Each intent family is assigned wholly to one split.
provenance.split_assignment: Stratified systematic random split, rng=random.Random(20260915): families grouped by topic_domain (groups in drafted order), shuffled within each group, concatenated; dev = every 3rd family starting at offset rng.randrange(3)=0; rest -> test. Query IDs numbered by drafted order within split; annotation_pilot = first 5 dev IDs. Not hand-picked.
provenance.reason: v1 dev labels (2026-10-05) showed topic mismatch with the corpus: 6/10 dev queries had no pair graded >=1 by either annotator.
